## tal-a11-p03

source_text: [and]-śivatattvamataḥ śūnyātiśūnyaṃ syādanāśri[vṛ]tam / yattu sarvāvibhāgātma svatantraṃ bodhasundaram saptatriṃśaṃ tu tatprāhustattvaṃ paraśivābhidham / tasyāpyuktanayādvedyabhāve@tra parikalpite yadāste hyanavacchinnaṃ tadaṣṭātriṃśamucyate / na cānavasthā hyevaṃ syāddṛśyatāṃ hi mahātmabhiḥ yadvedyaṃ kiṃcidābhāti tatkṣaye yatprakāśate / tattattvamiti nirṇītaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ hṛdi bhāsate tatkiṃ na kiṃcidvā kiṃcidityākāṅkṣāvaśe vapuḥ / cidānandasvatantraikarūpaṃ taditi deśane saptatriṃśaṃ samābhāti tatrākāṅkṣā ca nāparā / taccāpi klṛptavedyatvaṃ yatra bhāti sa cinmayaḥ aṣṭātriṃśattamaḥ so@pi bhāvanāyopadiśyate / yadi nāma tataḥ saptatriṃśa eva punarbhavet avibhāgasvatantratvacinmayatvādidharmatā / samaiva vedyīkaraṇaṃ kevalaṃ tvadhikaṃ yataḥ dharāyāṃ guṇatattvānte māyānte kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ / gandho raso rūpamantaḥ sūkṣmabhāvakrameṇa tu iti sthite naye śaktitattvānte@pyasti saukṣmyabhāk / sparśaḥ ko@pi sadā yasmai yoginaḥ spṛhayālavaḥ

## tal-a11-p04

source_text: [and]-tatsparśānte tu saṃvittiḥ śuddhacidvyomarūpiṇī / yasyāṃ rūḍhaḥ samabhyeti svaprakāśātmikāṃ parām ato vindurato nādo rūpamasmādato rasaḥ / ityuktaṃ kṣobhakatvena spande sparśastu no tathā mataṃ caitanmaheśasya śrīpūrve yadabhāṣata / dhārikāpyāyinī boddhrī pavitrī cāvakāśadā ebhiḥ śabdairvyavaharan nivṛttyādernijaṃ vapuḥ / pañcatattvavidhiḥ proktastritattvamadhunocyate vijñānākalaparyantamātmā vidyeśvarāntakam / śeṣe śivastritattve syādekatattve śivaḥ param imau bhedāvubhau tattvabhedamātrakṛtāviti / tattvādhvaivāyamitthaṃ ca na ṣaḍadhvasthiteḥ kṣatiḥ prakṛt pumānyatiḥ kālo māyā vidyeśasauśivau / śivaśca navatattve@pi vidhau tattvādhvarūpatā evamaṣṭādaśākhye@pi vidhau nyāyaṃ vadetsudhīḥ / yatra yatra hi bhogecchā tatprādhānyopayogataḥ anyāntarbhāvanātaśca dīkṣānantavibhedabhāk / tena ṣaṭtriṃśato yāvadekatattvavidhirbhavet tattvādhvaiva sa devena prokto vyāsasamāsataḥ / ekatattvavidhiścaiṣa suprabuddhaṃ guruṃ prati

## tal-a11-p05

source_text: [and]-śiṣyaṃ ca gatabhogāśamuditaḥ śaṃbhunā yataḥ / bhedaṃ visphārya visphārya śaktyā svacchandarūpayā svātmanyabhinne bhagavānnityaṃ viśramayan sthitaḥ / itthaṃ tryātmādhvano bhedaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥ meyabhāgagataḥ proktaḥ puratattvakalātmakaḥ / adhunā mātṛbhāgasthaṃ rūpaṃ tredhā nirūpyate yatpramāṇātmakaṃ rūpamadhvano mātṛbhāgagam / padaṃ hyavagamātmatvasamāveśāttaducyate tadeva ca padaṃ mantraḥ prakṣobhātpracyutaṃ yadā / guptabhāṣī yato mātā tūṣṇīṃbhūto vyavasthitaḥ tathāpi na vimarśātma rūpaṃ tyajati tena saḥ / pramāṇātmavimarśātmā mānavatkṣobhabhāṅnatu mantrāṇāṃ ca padānāṃ ca tenoktaṃ trikaśāsane / abhinnameva svaṃ rūpaṃ niḥspandakṣobhite param audāsīnyaparityāge prakṣobhānavarohaṇe / varṇādhvā mātṛbhāge syāt pūrvaṃ yā kathitā pramā sā tu pūrṇasvarūpatvādavibhāgamayī yataḥ / tata ekaikavarṇatvaṃ tattve tattve kṣamāditaḥ kṛtvā śaive pare proktāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā visargataḥ / tatra śaktiparispandastāvān prāk ca nirūpitaḥ

## tal-a11-p06

## tal-a11-p07

source_text: [and]-gacchankalanayā yogādadhvā proktaḥ kalātmakaḥ / śuddhe prameyatāyoge sūkṣmasthūlatvabhāgini tattvādhvabhuvanādhvatve krameṇānusaredguruḥ / prameyamānamātṝṇāṃ yadrūpamupari sthitam pramātmātra sthito@dhvāyaṃ varṇātmā dṛśyatāṃ kila / ucchalatsaṃvidāmātraviśrāntyāsvādayoginaḥ sarvābhidhānasāmarthyādaniyantritaśaktayaḥ / sṛṣṭāḥ svātmasahotthe@rthe dharāparyantabhāgini āmṛśantaḥ svacidbhūmau tāvato@rthānabhedataḥ / varṇaughāste pramārūpāṃ satyāṃ bibhrati saṃvidam bālāstiryakpramātāro ye@pyasaṃketabhāginaḥ / te@pyakṛtrimasaṃskārasārāmenāṃ svasaṃvidam bhinnabhinnāmupāśritya yānti citrāṃ pramātṛtām / asyā cākṛtrimānantavarṇasaṃvidi rūḍhatām saṃketā yānti cette@pi yāntyasaṃketavṛttitām / anayā tu vinā sarve saṃketā bahuśaḥ kṛtāḥ aviśrāntatayā kuryuranavasthāṃ duruttarām / bālo vyutpādyate yena tatra saṃketamārgaṇāt aṅgulyādeśane@pyasya nāvikalpā tathā matiḥ / vikalpaḥ śabdamūlaśca śabdaḥ saṃketajīvitaḥ

## tal-a11-p08

source_text: [and]-tenānanto hyamāyīyo yo varṇagrāma īdṛśaḥ / saṃvidvimarśasacivaḥ sadaiva sa hi jṛmbhate yata eva ca māyīyā varṇāḥ sūtiṃ vitenire / ye ca māyīyavarṇeṣu vīryatvena nirūpitāḥ saṃketanirapekṣāste prameti parigṛhyatām / tathā hi paravākyeṣu śruteṣvāvriyate nijā pramā yasya jaḍo@sau no tatrārthe@bhyeti mātṛtām / śukavatsa paṭhatyeva paraṃ tatkramitaikabhāk svātantryalābhataḥ svākyapramālābhe tu boddhṛtā / yasya hi svapramābodho vipakṣodbhedanigrahāt vākyādivarṇapuñje sve sa pramātā vaśībhavet / yathā yathā cākṛtakaṃ tadrūpamatiricyate tathā tathā camatkāratāratamyaṃ vibhāvyate / ādyāmāyīyavarṇāntarnimagne cottarottare sakete pūrvapūrvāṃśamajjane pratibhābhidaḥ / ādyodrekamahattve@pi pratibhātmani niṣṭhitāḥ dhruvaṃ kavitvavaktṛtvaśālitāṃ yānti sarvataḥ / yāvaddhāmani saṃketanikārakalanojjhite viśrāntaścinmaye kiṃ kiṃ na vetti kurute na vā / ata eva hi vāksiddhau varṇānāṃ samupāsyatā

## tal-a11-p09

source_text: [and]-sarvajñatvādisiddhau vā kā siddhiryā na tanmayī / taduktaṃ varadena śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate tena guptena guptāste śeṣā varṇāstviti sphuṭam / evaṃ māmātṛmānatvameyatvairyo@vabhāsate ṣaḍvidhaḥ svavapuḥśuddhau śuddhiṃ so@dhvādhigacchati / ekena vapuṣā śuddhau tatraivānyaprakāratām antarbhāvyācarecchuddhimanusaṃdhānavān guruḥ / anantarbhāvaśaktau tu sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tu śodhayet tadviśuddhaṃ bījabhāvāt sūte nottarasaṃtatim / śodhanaṃ bahudhā tattadbhogaprāptyekatānatā tadādhipatyaṃ tattyāgastacchivātmatvavedanam / tallīnatā tannirāsaḥ sarvaṃ caitatkramākramāt ata eva ca te mantrāḥ śodhakāścitrarūpiṇaḥ / siddhāntavāmadakṣādau citrāṃ śuddhiṃ vitanvate anuttaratrikānāmakramamantrāstu ye kila / te sarve sarvadāḥ kintu kasyācit kvāpi mukhyatā ataḥ śodhakabhāvena śāstre śrīpūrvasaṃjñite / parāparādimantrāṇāmadhvanyuktā vyavasthitiḥ śodhakatvaṃ ca mālinyā devīnāṃ tritayasya ca / devatrayasya vaktrāṇāmaṅgānāmaṣṭakasya ca

## tal-a11-p10

source_text: [and]-kiṃ vātibahunā dvāravāstvādhāragurukrame / lokapāstravidhau mantrān muktvā sarvaṃ viśodhakam yaccaitadadhvanaḥ proktaṃ śodhyatvaṃ śoddhṛtā ca yā / sā svātantryācchivābhede yuktetyuktaṃ ca śāsane sarvametadvibhātyeva parameśitari dhruve / pratibimbasvarūpeṇa na tu bāhyatayā yataḥ cidvyomnyeva śive tattaddehādimatirīdṛśī / bhinnā saṃsāriṇāṃ rajjau sarpasragvīcibuddhivat yataḥ prāgdehamaraṇasiddhāntaḥ svapnagocaraḥ / dehāntarādirmaraṇe kīdṛgvā dehasaṃbhavaḥ svapne@pi pratibhāmātrasāmānyaprathanābalāt / viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsante na bhāvyante@pi te yathā śālagrāmopalāḥ keciccitrākṛtibhṛto yathā / tathā māyādibhūmyantalekhācitrahṛdaścitaḥ nagarārṇavaśailādyāstadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ / na svayaṃ sadasanto no kāraṇākāraṇātmakāḥ niyateścirarūḍhāyāḥ samucchedātpravartanāt / arūḍhāyāḥ svatantro@yaṃ sthitaścidvyomabhairavaḥ ekacinmātrasaṃpūrṇabhairavābhedabhāgini / evamasmītyanāmarśo bhedako bhāvamaṇḍale

source_text: [and]-sarvapramāṇairno siddhaṃ svapne kartrantaraṃ yathā / svasaṃvidaḥ svasiddhāyāstathā sarvatra buddhyatām cittacitrapurodyāne krīḍedevaṃ hi vetti yaḥ / ahameva sthito bhūtabhāvatattvapurairiti evaṃ jāto mṛto@smīti janmamṛtyuvicitratāḥ / ajanmanyamṛtau bhānti cittabhittau svanirmitāḥ parehasaṃvidāmātraṃ paralokehalokate / vastutaḥ saṃvido deśaḥ kālo vā naiva kiṃcana abhaviṣyadayaṃ sargo mūrtaścenna tu cinmayaḥ / tadavekṣyata tanmadhyāt kenaiko@pi dharādharaḥ bhūtatanmātravargāderādhārādheyatākrame / ante saṃvinmayī śaktiḥ śivarūpaiva dhāriṇī tasmātpratītirevetthaṃ kartrī dhartrī ca sā śivaḥ / tato bhāvāstatra bhāvāḥ śaktirādhārikā tataḥ sāṃkalpikaṃ nirādhāramapi naiva patatyadhaḥ / svādhāraśaktau viśrāntaṃ viśvamitthaṃ vimṛśyatām asyā ghanāhamityādirūḍhireva dharāditā / yāvadante cidasmīti nirvṛttā bhairavātmatā maṇāvindrāyudhe bhāsa iva nīlādayaḥ śive / paramārthata eṣāṃ tu nodayo na vyayaḥ kvacit

## tal-a11-p12

source_text: [and]-deśe kāle@tra vā sṛṣṭirityetadasamañjasam / cidātmanā hi devena sṛṣṭirdikkālayorapi jāgarābhimate sārdhahastatritayagocare / prahare ca pṛthak svapnāścitradikkālamāninaḥ ata eva kṣaṇaṃ nāma na kiṃcidapi manmahe / kriyākṣaṇe vāpyekasmin bahvyaḥ saṃsyurdrutāḥ kriyāḥ tena ye bhāvasaṃkocaṃ kṣaṇāntaṃ pratipedire / te nūnamenayā nāḍyā śūnyadṛṣṭyavalambinaḥ tadya eṣa sato bhāvāñ śūnyīkartuṃ tathāsataḥ / sphuṭīkartuṃ svatantratvādīśaḥ so@smatprabhuḥ śivaḥ taditthaṃ parameśāno viśvarūpaḥ pragīyate / na tu bhinnasya kasyāpi dharāderupapannatā uktaṃ caitatpuraiveti na bhūyaḥ pravivicyate / bhūyobhiścāpi bāhyārthadūṣaṇaiḥ pravyaramyata taditthameṣa nirṇītaḥ kalādervistaro@dhvanaḥ
